capabilities: Save links as cards with cover, title, description and tags
Organize cards into collections with drag-and-drop
Search, filter and sort cards by date, title or site
Embed cards in notes with filter options (collection, search, domain, pinned)
Export and import links as a file or a Markdown note
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README documents privacy and network behavior: no telemetry, accounts or servers; covers are cached locally in Visualink/assets/, and cards are stored in .obsidian/plugins/visualink/data.json.
motivation: The author wanted a middle ground between dozens of open tabs and full-page clippers: close the tab and keep the link as a light card with its cover, title and description.
problem: Open tabs pile up and clippers like Obsidian Web Clipper save full page content when sometimes you only want to keep a link for later.

relations.evidence: Clippers like Obsidian Web Clipper are great when you want to keep an article's content.

summary: Link card manager that saves links as visual cards with cover, title, description and tags, organized into collections kept offline in the vault.
